summary: This document outlines the email request contact change functionality within a web application.
purpose: To manage and send emails related to contact changes, including validation and attachment handling.

workflows.name: Email Sending Workflow
steps: User fills in email form with necessary details.
Validation occurs to check email fields and attachments.
Upon successful validation, email is sent with attachments.
Warning and error panels display respective messages based on email sending results.

business_rules: Email must have a subject and body.
Attachments should not be empty if added.
Email addresses are validated against a specified regex pattern.
validations: Check if the email subject and body are specified.
Validate email addresses against a regex pattern.
Display error messages if validation fails.
calculations: String manipulation for email addresses and attachment URLs.
Concatenation of message bodies and signatures.
conditions: Visibility of email fields and panels is dependent on user input and system configurations.
system_behavior: JavaScript handling for email validations and UI behavior.
Attachment handling with unique folder creation.
exceptions: No recipients specified results in no email being sent.
Errors in file handling could result in attachment failures.
